author: The Infographics Show
description:
Scientists just discovered hidden waves moving across the surface of the Sun, and they could change how we understand solar storms.

Using the powerful Daniel K. Inouye Solar Telescope, scientists spotted strange waves moving across the Sun’s surface. These waves twist and roll through the Sun’s superheated gas, carrying huge amounts of energy. This discovery could help explain a mystery scientists have struggled with for decades. Why the Sun’s outer atmosphere is much hotter than its surface.
It could also help us better understand how powerful solar storms form. And that matters because those storms can hit Earth and disrupt satellites, GPS, communications, and even power grids.

The better we understand these hidden solar waves, the better chance we have of predicting what the Sun throws at us next.
